proposal.summary: The TIOCLINUX ioctl request allows a malicious snap to inject contents into the input of the controlling terminal, potentially executing arbitrary commands outside of the snap sandbox.

AV.quote: This can only be exploited when snaps are run on a virtual console.

PR.quote: a malicious snap could inject contents into the input of the controlling terminal.

C.quote: allow it to cause arbitrary commands to be executed outside of the snap sandbox after the snap exits.

proposal.recommended_next_step: Investigate the use of TIOCLINUX ioctl requests in snap packages and implement input validation.
